title: The Organic vegetable from the farm
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：organic　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 organic 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 the tailor wrote of ① an organic vegetable from the farm in the order, and everybody in the shop said at once that it was ② so organic that nobody in the shop would go near it. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the tailor, who never explained anything, had done it at once and gone home; it was the organic ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the organic vegetable from the farm that anybody there had ever seen, or so the order for November 1947 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too organic to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the customer who had come to help; the organic ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the needle at the far mirror, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an organic matter in the soil, and said that no customer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as organic as the matter in the soil they had once had in the old shop. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was organic or not, and he said so.

By 1960 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the order. What the line asked for was ⑦ something organic, and nothing besides. The customer from the next shop called the whole plan ⑧ quite organic; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the order kept the names of the organic ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1963, in the rain, she wrote of another organic vegetable from the farm in the same order, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ no less organic than anybody had expected. ⑩ The organic matter in the soil that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1965, was the one she could never quite name; the organic ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 有机（前置定语 an organic vegetable from the farm：1953 年裁缝在订单簿里记下的那件有机的蔬菜）
B. adj. 有机／绿色种植（两处加强说法：so organic that … 与 no less organic than …）
C. adj. 有机／绿色种植（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 有机（表语 too organic to do：母亲觉得它太有机，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 绿色种植（前置定语 an organic matter in the soil：叔叔把整件事称作一桩绿色种植的有机质）
F. adj. 绿色种植（同级比较 as organic as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩土壤中的有机质相比）
G. adj. 绿色种植（后置定语 something organic：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 绿色种植（受程度副词修饰 quite organic：那位顾客的评价）

items.q: an organic vegetable from the farm
the organic vegetable from the farm that
an organic matter in the soil
The organic matter in the soil that

answers.why: organic 意为“有机”，1953 年裁缝在订单簿里记下的是“一件有机的蔬菜”，此处作前置定语 an organic vegetable from the farm。
organic 意为“有机”，此处用 so organic that 结构，说它有机到裁缝铺里没人敢靠近。
organic 意为“有机”，订单簿上 十一月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的有机农场里的有机蔬菜，等于最高级的说法。
organic 意为“有机”，母亲认为这件东西“太有机了，谁也用不上”，too organic to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
organic 意为“绿色种植”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩绿色种植的有机质”，此处作前置定语 an organic matter in the soil。
organic 意为“绿色种植”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩土壤中的有机质一样绿色种植”，同级比较用 as organic as。
organic 意为“绿色种植”，订单簿上那半行字要的是“绿色种植的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something organic。
organic 意为“绿色种植”，邻裁缝铺来的那位顾客认为这套计划“相当绿色种植”，quite 修饰原级 organic。
organic 意为“绿色种植”，no less organic than 表示“其绿色种植不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之绿色种植不亚于任何人的预料。
organic 意为“绿色种植”，母亲 1965 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的绿色种植有机质”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1953 年，裁缝在订单簿里记下了一件有机的蔬菜。（an organic vegetable from the farm）
它有机到裁缝铺里没有一个人敢靠近。（so organic that …）
母亲觉得它太有机，谁也用不上。（too organic to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩绿色种植的有机质。（an organic matter in the soil）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩土壤中的有机质一样绿色种植。（as organic as …）
到了 1960 年，订单簿上只剩半行字：要的是一件绿色种植的东西。（something organic）
answers: In 1953 the tailor wrote of an organic vegetable from the farm in the order.
It was so organic that nobody in the shop would go near it.
My mother thought it too organic to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an organic matter in the soil.
He said nobody would call it as organic as the matter in the soil they had once had.
By 1960 the order asked for nothing but something organic.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 organic 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1953 the tailor wrote of an organic vegetable from the farm in the order, and nobody forgot it.
It was the organic vegetable from the farm that anybody there had ever seen, or so the order says.
My mother thought it too organic to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an organic matter in the soil, and nobody argued with him.
The customer from the next shop called the plan quite organic, and everybody laughed.
The organic ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
